local function reg_query(path, value)

    local romans = {
        [" I"] = " 1",

        [" V"] = " 5",
        [" VI"] = " 6",
        [" VII"] = " 7",
        [" VIII"] = " 8",
        [" IX"] = " 9",
        [" X"] = " 10"
    }

    for numeral, substitution in pairs(romans) do
        if endsWith(gameName, numeral) then
            gameName = string.sub(gameName, 1, -string.len(numeral) - 1) .. substitution
        end
    end

    return gameName
end

    interval = interval or 0
